style: Abrasive avant-rock and street-choir ritual with township rhythmic drive, dry body percussion, and antiphonal vocal choirs. Harmony uses modal drone fields interrupted by quartal side-steps and chromatic microtonal rubs. Rhythm employs 3:2 pulse coupling between a heavy compound stomp substrate and syncopated asymmetrical subdivisions. Timbre features group stomps, plastic bins, metal chains, teeth chatter, mouth pops, and whisper clouds. Vocals use hocket relays, phonetic percussive attacks, glottal stops, ejective consonants, and nasal resonance. Performance attitude is hyper-articulate, obsessive, and fiercely disciplined. Operator rules: hold the primary feline invariant fixed while rhythm and vowel quantity compress; alternate choral call-and-response with fractured nonlexical mouth events; compress harmonic tension while stretching temporal register cascades across physical spatial dimensions and mineral densities and absolute basaltic pressure nodes.
